title: Each type's chai order
caption:
Tell us your chai order and we'll tell you your type. Honestly, it's that obvious.

One and a half sugar, measured. Kashmiri chai with adrak, 'as an experiment'. A cup that went cold an hour ago and is being drunk anyway. Sixteen types, sixteen very different cups.

Send this to whoever makes the chai at your house, and say shukriya while you're at it.

What's your exact chai order? Be specific.

Free test: link in bio (mizaj.pk)
